checks.explanation: The predicted roughly-decade timeframe (around 2034) hasn't arrived.
The predicted 3-7 year window (2027-2031) hasn't elapsed, and no quantum computer capable of breaking classical encryption exists yet.
The predicted 2-5 year window (2026-2029) hasn't elapsed; current quantum hardware remains far below the thousands of logical qubits needed.
No major commercial quantum computing product or application has emerged as of 2026, consistent with the prediction so far, but the full ~10-year window (to 2034) hasn't closed.
Shein faced significant new difficulties in the US market under the Trump administration, including the elimination of the de minimis import exemption it had relied on for low-cost shipping.
The Trump administration implemented substantial new tariffs on Chinese imports beginning in 2025, well beyond December 2024 levels.
